facts.fact: PPRA director general Dennis Simba says NeST, operational since September 2023, lets suppliers submit bids remotely and has become the main channel for advertising and processing government tenders.

Under the Public Procurement Act of 2023 and its 2024 regulations procurement must be conducted through NeST, which also prepares and signs contracts electronically and verifies tender securities through connected banks.
PPRA reports NeST has processed 430,643 tenders worth Sh42.6 trillion since September 2023.
